events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller has arrived late.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller was stuck at work.
Ross Geller says there was a big dinosaur-related situation at Ross Geller's workplace.
Carol Willick says Ross Geller remembers Susan Bunch.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller cannot forget Susan Bunch.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Carol Willick, and Susan Bunch are waiting for Dr. Oberman.
Ross Geller asks whether Dr. Oberman is male.
Ross Geller asks whether Dr. Oberman is familiar with the special situation involving Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, and Carol Willick.
Carol Willick says Dr. Oberman is very supportive of the special situation involving Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller says it is great that Dr. Oberman is very supportive of the special situation involving Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller starts to say what Ross Geller is, but stops mid-sentence.
Carol Willick says Ross Geller's 'Quack, quack' sound opens Carol Willick's cervix.
